title: Zesty Croatian Shrimp Pilaf
description: A classic Croatian dish with a twist, featuring succulent shrimp and a zesty flavor, this pilaf is a hearty and satisfying meal that is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the rice and stir to combine with the shrimp and onion mixture.
Add the chicken broth, paprika, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
